rule: Each row uses only the original destination phrase stored by the frozen DINO parser. Remove English leading determiners (a/an/the/this/that/my) and take final alphabetic token as the head. Use the full stripped phrase and its final head as prompt variants of ONE positive class, normalized average of their unit CLIP text vectors (unique prompts). Each other lexically normalized training category is a class with a single prompt. Remove negatives exactly equal to the positive phrase or head. Every prompt uses a photo of a {name}. The positive class is accepted if its cosine is among the top five of this training lexicon plus positive. Ties count against positive. Never include another development instruction or target index in the vocab or score. Do not tune. Output positive class rank, score, top5, lexical context and pool sizes.
crop: Use original 320x240 RGB and archived absolute xyxy float DINO box. Clip the box to the image before measuring its center/extent. The integer square side is ceil(2*max(box width,height)). Center it with floor of (center-side/2), clip source intersection to frame, and pad off-image pixels with the CLIP processor mean RGB. Preserve full square original aspect for CLIP input. Assert archived normalized geometry agrees with the clipped bbox before prediction. An absent box never passes.
stop: Both consecutive fresh observations must pass top5, and the unchanged prior learned geometry STOP must pass both. Same evaluation on 30 windows (5 train and 5 dev instances, each with matched near / mismatched near / matched far). Report original detector-centric, learned STOP and learned+CLIP counts. Gate=development at least 3/5 true positives with zero same-image wrong and zero same-goal far false positives. All conditions and class names are fixed before CLIP scoring. Development used previously; do not treat this as a new population.
